metric_policy: Premier League ratings use true opponent-adjusted xG half-life-5 priors where available. Promoted teams without current PL OAW coverage use last Championship season goals for/against converted to Premier League scale with the historical promotion tax; once promoted teams have completed PL matches, ratings blend current PL OAW N/38 with the promoted adjustment (38-N)/38 until a full 38-match PL season is available.
